国庆节第二天还休息一天。

宿舍里的人一早就开始吵吵，商量着去哪儿逛。刘卫东想去故宫，陈志远想去颐和园，李建国说哪儿都不去就想在宿舍躺着。争了半天，最后分成两拨，一拨去故宫，一拨去颐和园，谁也不想躺宿舍。

王建新把休息名额分配好后，自己留在了宿舍。他坐到书桌前，拿出罗大夫那本手抄本，继续抄写。纸张泛黄，边角磨得发毛，他翻的时候很小心，生怕弄坏了。毛笔字工工整整，一笔一划，有些地方还有红笔批注，字迹不一样，有的粗有的细，有的工整有的潦草，一看就是几代人留下的。

他已经快抄写完了，每天晚上在空间都会抄写一段时间。用钢笔抄，字写得很小，但工整。抄完一页，对照原稿检查一遍，确认没错，再翻下一页。

中午在食堂吃完饭，下午去后勤组把这个月的钱票领了。排着队，一个一个来，轮到他的时候，工作人员把信封递给他，他打开看了看，钱和票都在，跟以前一样。

从后勤组出来，他又拐到军人服务社。服务社里人不多，柜台后面的售货员在打毛衣，看见他进来，放下针线，问他要什么。

“拿一条飞马。”

售货员从柜台下面拿出一条飞马烟，十盒一条，用玻璃纸封着。王建新把烟票递过去，又数了钱，售货员收了，把烟推过来。

他这是凑够了一条——上个月的烟票买了五盒，这个月的又买了五盒，正好凑成一条，准备下次回家带给父亲。父亲抽了一辈子烟，舍不得买好的，都是自己卷旱烟。上次拿回去的几盒，他抽得很省，一盒能抽好几天。

他把烟揣进挎包里，转身要走，发现赵振国不知道什么时候站在了身后，俩眼直勾勾地盯着他的挎包。

“看什么呢？”王建新问。

“队长，你那烟……”赵振国咽了口唾沫。

王建新被他盯得心里毛毛的。赵振国是个老烟枪，一天不抽烟就坐不住，烟票早就用完了，这两天蹭别人的烟抽，蹭得刘卫东见他就躲。

“行行行，别看了。”王建新把那条烟从挎包里掏出来，拆开玻璃纸，打开烟盒，给抽烟的一人分了两盒。赵振国、林大山、郭大江，一人两盒。刘卫东不抽烟，没要。

赵振国接过烟，手都在抖，嘴里念叨着“队长你真是我亲哥”。

王建新把剩下的四盒重新包好，塞回挎包里。回家给父亲带四盒也行，够他抽一阵子了。

当天晚上，王建新没有进空间。

他在空间里换了衣服——一件灰不溜秋的旧中山装，不知从哪儿收来的，领口磨得发白，袖子也短了点，穿着有点紧。又在脸上抹了点灰，用一块黑布蒙住了半张脸，只露出眼睛和额头。对着镜子照了照，亲妈都认不出来。

他打听好了黑市的位置，在城北的一条胡同里，离学校不近。坐了两站公交车，又走了一刻钟，才找到那条胡同。

胡同很窄，没有路灯，黑漆漆的。他往里走了几十步，看见一个院门口站着两个人。那两个人穿着一身黑，膀大腰圆，一看就不是善茬。门口没有灯，但月光照下来，能看清他们的脸，一个刀疤脸，一个络腮胡。

“干什么的？”刀疤脸拦住他。

“进去转转。”王建新说。

“五分钱。”

王建新从兜里掏出五分钱，递过去。刀疤脸收了钱，让开身子，朝院子里努了努嘴：“进去吧，规矩懂吧？别闹事。”

王建新点了点头，进了院子。

院子不大，但里面很热闹。几间屋子都亮着灯，门口有人进进出出。他推开一扇门，里面是一个大房间，摆着几排木架子，架子上摆着各种东西——布匹、粮食、油盐酱醋、烟酒糖茶、搪瓷盆、暖水瓶、针头线脑，什么都有。人不少，有的在挑东西，有的在讨价还价，声音压得很低，但嗡嗡嗡的，像一窝蜜蜂。

王建新在里边转了一圈。东西种类很多很全，但肉还是稀缺，只在角落里看见一小块猪肉，用油纸包着，不知道多少钱。其他东西倒是不缺，布匹有好几种颜色，粮食有大米白面，还有市面上少见的白糖和茶叶。

他看了几眼，没买。这些他空间里都有，用不着在这儿花钱。

他走出屋子，来到门口，跟那个刀疤脸搭话：“兄弟，我要买一大批中药种子，跟谁联系？”

We have a day off on the second day of National Day.

People in the dormitory started making noise early in the morning, discussing where to go.Liu Weidong wanted to go to the Forbidden City, Chen Zhiyuan wanted to go to the Summer Palace, and Li Jianguo said he didn't want to go anywhere and just wanted to lie down in the dormitory.After arguing for a long time, they were finally divided into two groups. One group went to the Forbidden City and the other to the Summer Palace. No one wanted to stay in the dormitory.

After Wang Jianxin allocated the rest places, he stayed in the dormitory.He sat down at the desk, took out Dr. Luo's manuscript, and continued copying.The paper was yellowed and the edges were frayed. He turned it over carefully for fear of damaging it.The calligraphy is neat, stroke by stroke, and there are red pen annotations in some places. The handwriting is different, some thick and some thin, some neat and some scrawled. At first glance, it can be seen that it was left by several generations.

He has almost finished copying, and he will copy for a while in space every night.Copy it with a pen. The writing is very small but neat.After copying one page, check it against the original to make sure it is correct, and then turn to the next page.

After eating in the cafeteria at noon, I went to the logistics team in the afternoon to collect this month's coupons.They lined up and came one by one. When it was his turn, the staff handed him the envelope. He opened it and looked at it. The money and tickets were there, just like before.

After leaving the logistics team, he turned to the Military Service Club.There were not many people in the service club. The salesperson behind the counter was knitting a sweater. When she saw him coming in, she put down her sewing and asked him what he wanted.

"Get a Pegasus."

The salesperson took out a pack of ten Pegasus cigarettes from under the counter and sealed them with cellophane.Wang Jianxin handed over the cigarette ticket and counted the money. The salesperson took it and pushed the cigarette over.

He had scraped together enough for one pack - he bought five boxes of cigarette tickets last month, and bought five more boxes for this month's cigarettes, which made up just enough for one pack, ready to be taken to his father next time he went home.My father had smoked cigarettes all his life and was reluctant to buy good ones, so he rolled his own dry cigarettes.He smoked the boxes he took back last time very sparingly, and he could smoke one box for several days.

He put the cigarette into his satchel, turned to leave, and found Zhao Zhenguo standing behind him at some point, staring directly at his satchel.

"What are you looking at?" Wang Jianxin asked.

"Captain, that cigarette of yours..." Zhao Zhenguo swallowed.

Wang Jianxin was so stared at that he felt very anxious.Zhao Zhenguo is a long-time smoker. He can't sit still without smoking for a day, and his cigarette tickets have long been used up. In the past two days, he has smoked other people's cigarettes, which made Liu Weidong hide away when he saw him.

"Okay, okay, don't look at it." Wang Jianxin took out the cigarette from his bag, unwrapped the cellophane, opened the cigarette box, and gave two boxes to each smoker.Zhao Zhenguo, Lin Dashan, Guo Dajiang, two boxes each.Liu Weidong doesn't smoke, so he didn't ask for it.

Zhao Zhenguo took the cigarette, his hands were shaking, and he muttered, "Captain, you are really my brother."

Wang Jianxin rewrapped the remaining four boxes and stuffed them back into his satchel.You can bring four boxes to your father when you go home, which will be enough for him to smoke for a while.

That night, Wang Jianxin did not enter the space.

He changed clothes in the space - a gray old Chinese tunic suit, collected from somewhere, the collar was frayed white, the sleeves were a little short, and it was a little tight.He smeared some ash on his face and covered half of his face with a piece of black cloth, leaving only his eyes and forehead exposed.I looked in the mirror and couldn't even recognize my mother.

He inquired about the location of the black market, which was in an alley in the north of the city, not close to the school.After taking the bus for two stops and walking for a quarter of an hour, I found the alley.

The alley is very narrow, there are no street lights, and it is pitch black.He walked dozens of steps inside and saw two people standing at the entrance of a courtyard.The two men were dressed in all black and had big shoulders and round waists. At first glance, they were not good friends.There was no light at the door, but in the moonlight, one could clearly see their faces, one with a scar and the other with a beard.

"What are you doing?" Scarface stopped him.

"Go in and take a look around." Wang Jianxin said.

"Five cents."

Wang Jianxin took out five cents from his pocket and handed it over.Scarface accepted the money, stepped aside, and gestured towards the yard: "Come in, do you understand the rules? Don't make trouble."

Wang Jianxin nodded and entered the yard.

The yard is not big, but it is very lively inside.Several rooms had lights on, and people were coming in and out of the doorways.He opened a door, and inside was a large room with several rows of wooden shelves. On the shelves were various things - cloth, grain, oil, salt, soy and vinegar, tobacco, wine, sugar and tea, enamel basins, thermos bottles, needles, thread, everything.There were a lot of people, some were picking things, some were haggling, their voices were low but buzzing like a swarm of bees.

Wang Jianxin walked around inside.There are many kinds of food, but the meat is still scarce. I only saw a small piece of pork in the corner, wrapped in oil paper, and I don’t know how much it cost.There is no shortage of other things. Cloths come in several colors, grains include rice and white flour, and white sugar and tea are rare on the market.

He looked at it a few times but didn't buy it.He has all these in his space, so there is no need to spend money here.

He walked out of the house, came to the door, and talked to the scar-faced man: "Brother, I want to buy a large amount of Chinese medicine seeds, who should I contact?"
